summary: See docs/notes/orphan-graft-map.md. Controls f0eb2f96 (G3, Mathlib three axioms; laws 4-5 single effect and one creature, MediatedOptimum on chainG): stability under the giving-output adapter is fixity; a unique optimum makes a root fixed toward every effect, so a unique-optimum root cannot be a mixed-mode root (it gives exactly one being per accessible world where it exists), though without direct reach it can be the mediated creator (chainG satisfies the rival); with SS the rival makes WN fail; a tied-optimum model keeps the root two-way. blocker: Not blocked for G1 and G2. WN's warrant is unchanged. Standing rivals of WN: selective diffusion ea1425c0 and the world-level optimizer 78af5042; the mediated creator is a standing rival of G1's reach premise 0c27f65a. A unique-optimum root cannot be a mixed-mode root (it gives exactly one being per accessible world where it exists). Without direct reach it can be the mediated creator: #1947's chainG satisfies the rival with candidates {g} (G3 MediatedOptimum), so G1 does not touch it. With direct reach it collapses to one creature. Ties do not force fixity (the tied model, one encoding).
